caelestia.role: Initial upstream source baseline; local port commits follow this commit.

Preserves nunreasonable/quickshell e8ae0ef124b1c14b547c80d00422d2ffbd423d81, native mask hover handoff, Core Audio capability/error reporting, UPower observation validity, GSMTC initialization/session-scan status and profile-isolated artwork caching.
